properties.name: app.password-policy.min-length
properties.description: Minimum length of a new password, in characters.

properties.name: app.password-policy.max-length
properties.description: Maximum length of a new password, in UTF-8 bytes (bcrypt reads at most 72).

properties.name: app.password-policy.require-uppercase
properties.description: Require at least one upper-case letter in a new password.

properties.name: app.password-policy.require-lowercase
properties.description: Require at least one lower-case letter in a new password.

properties.name: app.password-policy.require-digit
properties.description: Require at least one digit in a new password.

properties.name: app.password-policy.require-special
properties.description: Require at least one character that is neither a letter nor a digit in a new password.

properties.name: app.rate-limit.login-requests-per-minute
properties.description: Maximum login attempts allowed per IP address per minute.

properties.name: app.rate-limit.registration-requests-per-minute
properties.description: Maximum account registration requests allowed per IP address per minute.

properties.name: app.rate-limit.url-creation-requests-per-minute
properties.description: Maximum short URL creation requests allowed per authenticated user per minute.

properties.name: app.rate-limit.redirect-requests-per-minute
properties.description: Maximum redirect requests allowed per IP address per minute.
